goals: Verify that the index page is successfully served and includes the required MSAL CDN link.
Verify that the MSAL authentication configuration object is defined and contains a valid client ID and authority URI.
activities: Read the local index.html file content synchronously
Load the HTML content into the global document element
Verify the 'src' attribute of the 'load-msal' element contains the expected CDN link
Load the MSAL configuration object into the global scope
Verify the MSAL configuration object is defined
Verify the client ID in the configuration object matches a GUID regex pattern
Verify the authority in the configuration object matches a URI regex pattern
Set the Node environment variable to 'test'
Send a GET request to the root ('/') endpoint
Read the local index.html file content asynchronously
Verify the response status code is 200
